result.summary: Nine exact unstable BB-flop rows completed 16x16x3 sampling with 768 outcomes per legal action. Development/adaptive continuation-CVaR2of3 action agreement was 0.1111 and heldout/adaptive 0.3333. Heldout choices retained 3.36 bb mean adaptive marginal regret, 1/9 above 5 bb, and the adaptive selector introduced two highest-risk actions.
result.conclusion: Do not train a hard BB-flop CVaR point label on these unstable rows or add more uniform-hole runouts expecting the two 8x8 labels to converge.
result.next_step: Use consensus with explicit training-time abstention on unstable rows, or change the hidden-hole posterior, continuation model, or distributional/pairwise objective.
